name: Malhar Dehadrai
player_statement:
A complete player, Malhar Dehadrai has made a big mark in cricket. With 26 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 22*, with an average of 7.05 and a quick strike rate of 50.34. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 9 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 71.1 overs, taking 26 wickets at an economy rate of 4.75. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
